items.prompt: A late-1990s trance party in a warehouse: a dense crowd of dancers in silhouette, arms raised, beams of light slicing through thick smoke above them, one figure standing still in the middle of the movement.

alt.ru: Транс-вечеринка конца 1990-х в ангаре: толпа танцующих силуэтов с поднятыми руками, лучи света в дыму, одна фигура посередине стоит неподвижно.
alt.en: A late-1990s trance party in a warehouse: a crowd of dancing silhouettes, arms raised, light beams in smoke, one figure standing still in the middle.
alt.pt: Uma festa trance do fim dos anos 90 num armazém: multidão de silhuetas a dançar, braços no ar, feixes de luz no fumo, uma figura imóvel ao centro.
alt.es: Una fiesta trance de finales de los noventa en una nave: una multitud de siluetas bailando, brazos en alto, haces de luz en el humo, una figura inmóvil en el centro.
